observation: With five independently sampled negatives per positive on the same split, the evaluation is 13,807 pairs, 11,493 unique negatives and a 16.76% base rate. Histogram base features were best at 0.683398/0.620132; GraphSAGE scored 0.304360/0.218772, RGCN 0.130120/0.141856, GATv2 0.092534/0.091171 and GNN+histogram 0.118811/0.123371.

title: Fair per-positive negatives reverse the model ranking
